On Google, he dismisses the selloff over DeepMind leadership changes (Hassabis moving to chair, Jeff Dean leaving) as headline noise; the moat is vertical integration and TPUs, and Google Cloud accelerating to 81.8% growth matters far more. Meta (BUY) gets positive news: Muse Spark 1.2 cracking top-5 on the VAL index at a fraction of rivals' cost, plus reports Meta could sell up to 400K GPUs externally — a sentiment game-changer. Uber (HOLD) and Axon (HOLD) both reported strong quarters but sold off; he is happy with his Uber allocation and holds his small, expensive Axon position.
